title: Building Scalable Systems with Apache Airflow: A Data Engineer's Guide
tldr: Scaling Apache Airflow to handle enterprise workflows requires moving beyond basic executors and decoupling execution from orchestration. By optimizing executor architecture, keeping DAG files free of top-level dependencies, and tuning scheduler parameters, data engineers can scale pipelines to thousands of daily runs without bottlenecking the system.
excerpt: Learn how to architect, optimize, and maintain production-ready Apache Airflow environments that scale seamlessly to thousands of daily tasks.
